prose_updates.tldr: The headline result prices the loss from using Bernoulli-label data to select the welfare-maximizing exact-count policy: on every declared tied-best face, the optimized best-policy simple-regret ratio is bounded by active exact-hit mass with an exact equality frontier, and the squared ratio gives the cluster-count penalty. Separate observed-law theorems establish finite-sample nuisance deletion, full-menu calibrated CLTs, active-face LAN lower experiments, and tie-valid rank inference. The closest same-target estimator is transcribed exactly from Han--Owusu--Shin Appendix-B Eq. (S1); its derived influence variance reveals cross-label, assignment-cell, and Horvitz--Thompson participation losses. For a non-symmetric three-policy menu, exact arithmetic reports the hit matrix, its column masses, and its unique maximum-mass normalized column; the general certified routine supplies optimizer and risk enclosures once a variance vector and tolerance are specified, but no executed numerical transcript is reported here. A screened hierarchical construction certifies the noncompact general-K game across retained partial-tie faces and uniformly positive-definite covariance cells, with explicit zero-rate boundary handling and full quotient-ball primitive transfer.
prose_updates.related_work:
HanOwusuShin2026 is the closest same-estimand paper, but its decision action is a full vector of pairwise rankings under additive pairwise regret, whereas the headline mechanism game here selects one welfare-maximizing policy under simple regret. The nuisance-deletion theorem separately covers the published ranking action.

HanOwusuShin2026 is the closest same-target paper. Its Appendix-B Eq. (S1), pp. 40--44, uses the Horvitz--Thompson normalization \(1/(Cp_k)\) and a within-label likelihood ratio; the exact comparison theorem derives its influence variance and strictly refines it through cross-label assignment calibration. HiranoPorter2009 supplies the limit-experiment architecture, but the all-rule nuisance-deletion theorem and legal observed-law exact-hit tangent are specific to this model. BairdBohrenMcIntoshOzler2018 makes saturation shares a design object under a power criterion rather than optimized facewise simple regret. Joo2025 informs the static Gaussian selector; the contribution here is its coupling to the exact-hit polytope, a general certified outer-design procedure over the exact-hit polytope, and calibrated cluster-data transfer, not a new generic Gaussian minimax construction. Kato2026, arXiv:2506.24007v6 dated 25 July 2026, is Masahiro Kato's adaptive sequential best-arm comparator and only informs the certification architecture. LoombaEckles2026 informs score projection under structured interference. JiangImaiMalani2023 and MogstadRomanoShaikhWilhelm2024 inform the supporting covariance and rank-inversion results. ChanNakamuraSakaiForastiere2023 is nonarchival prior use of cross-label information for a different hypothetical-allocation target. EggerHaushoferMiguelNiehausWalker2022 supplies the prospective Kenya saturation-design consumer.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The results concern fixed \(n\), fixed \(K\), equal cluster sizes, distinct interior rational saturations, isolated iid cluster schedules, and exact-slice welfare. Bernoulli-label and exact-count complete randomization are mutually exclusive regimes, and all scores are defined under their induced observed laws. Active-face CR results allow zero inactive shares, but the full-menu CR CLT and rank theorem require every reported share to be positive. At a unique best policy first-order local regret is zero. When \(K=2\), the face game reduces to the classical sign rule and Neyman allocation; assignment-homogeneous slice means eliminate the calibration component but not necessarily the Horvitz--Thompson participation term in Eq. (S1). The finite positive-face Gaussian certificate is a theorem target; the three-policy calculation reports only exact hit-matrix and column-mass arithmetic, not an executed optimizer or risk certificate. The Kenya design is a prospective design consumer rather than an authorized reanalysis. For the Appendix-B Eq. (S1) comparator, the note matches the published equal-size, finite-interior-menu, iid-cluster, bounded-outcome, unrestricted within-cluster-interference class, while dropping unnecessary smoothness and allowing boundary nominal-label shares via cross-label hits. Han–Owusu–Shin’s broader main complete-randomization envelope also permits heterogeneous integral cluster sizes; the present equal-size converse transfers upward as a lower bound on that broader class, but the efficient upper construction, single hit map, and exact mechanism frontier are not claimed there.
